name: Doughbox
summary: A business bank app for a bakery with three shops: jars to pour between, staff cards and payments
about: A soft, warm business banking app for a small business with a few shops, shown with a bakery. Accounts are jars you can drag onto each other to pour money across, staff cards flip to show their details and freeze in one tap, and payments go out with a live preview and a code to approve. Shop takings, team permissions and approvals sit alongside.
how: Watch your total balance count up on Home and switch the balance chart between 7D, 30D and 90D.
On Jars, drag one account jar onto another, pick an amount and watch the liquid pour across with coins flying.
Flip a staff card to see its details, reveal the number and CVV for 10 seconds, freeze it, or slide its monthly limit.
Send money: pick a payee and amount, review the preview, type any 4-digit code and see the tick draw in.
Approve or decline staff payment requests on Team, and change who can pay bills or send money.
Search and re-categorise transactions, compare shops by weekday, and export CSV.
